scientific_integrity: Explicit exact half-prefix formula and all-size proof; exact finite tests corroborate but do not replace proof. The constituent ballot and contact counts are classical. Historical priority for the conditional likelihood-ratio theorem is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to uniformly sampled nonnegative simple-walk excursions at their temporal midpoint.
Does not establish analogous orders for arbitrary observation times, weights, or unrestricted bridges.
Two older articles on joint local times and excursion statistics could not be read in full; implicit prior coverage remains possible.
title: Reverse likelihood-ratio ordering of midpoint height and zero contacts in uniform Dyck excursions
